# Synthetic vLLM metrics exposition.
#
# SYNTHETIC - hand-written, NOT captured from a running engine. Nothing here is
# evidence of what any engine emits; vllm_metrics_real.txt is the capture, and
# it is the authority on names, labels and bucket layouts.
#
# This file exists for one thing: values chosen so the bucket-interpolation
# arithmetic is checkable by hand.
#
# The values are chosen to match the Phase 1 TTFT distribution so that the
# bucket-resolution loss is demonstrable: the nine observations below are
# 26, 55, 55, 55, 55, 61, 61, 61, 61 ms, whose exact median is 55 ms.
#
# HELP vllm:num_requests_running Number of requests currently running on GPU.
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_running gauge
vllm:num_requests_running{engine="0",model_name="Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct"} 8.0
# HELP vllm:num_requests_waiting Number of requests waiting to be processed.
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_waiting gauge
